name: leave-request-check
title: Leave Request Check
description: Leave request field that reads the range as calendar days, working days and leave really used, and flags weekend or holiday ends, a sandwich rule charging days between, half days with no half or a gap, a negative balance and teammates away, with fixes.

meta.summary: Reads a time-off request back day by day, so it doesn't use more leave than the person thinks or leave a gap they didn't intend.
catches: Weekends or holidays at either end of the range
Your policy's sandwich rule charging weekends or holidays in between
Half day with no half chosen, or one that leaves a working gap
Too many teammates away at once
Start after end, and the actual back-at-work date
limits: Holidays, policy and balance come from your props; it doesn't know your HR system
The OSH Code note is shown for en-IN by default; whether it applies depends on the worker and establishment
a11y: Start and end dates have visible labels; half-day selects have aria-labels
Date inputs get aria-invalid for an invalid or reversed range
Day-by-day readback is a labelled section with a labelled list
Focus moves to the first fix after a change

sources.label: OSH Code 2020, s.32(1)(iv) (PRS Legislative Research copy of the Act)

rules.note: Informational, not legal advice. s.32(1)(iv) wording confirmed. The 21 Nov 2025 commencement (S.O. 5321(E)) was seen in secondary sources only, and the Maharashtra Shops & Establishments s.18(9) reference was not checked.
